PRINTERS.py.summary: The Printers class is a comprehensive iOS Smart app page object that manages printer discovery, connection, and setup workflows. It inherits from SmartFlow and implements extensive test automation patterns including: (1) Multi-path printer addition flows (WiFi, Ethernet, IP address, serial number), (2) Robust element verification with configurable timeouts and exception handling, (3) Platform-specific logic for iOS and MAC differences, (4) Retry mechanisms for flaky printer discovery operations, (5) Bluetooth popup detection and dismissal, (6) Bidirectional scrolling for printer list navigation, (7) Dynamic element locators with format specifiers for printer identification, (8) Comprehensive UI validation methods for multiple screen states (empty list, WiFi off, connection errors), (9) Search and filter capabilities for printer discovery, (10) End-to-end flows combining multiple steps (add_printer_ip method). The class demonstrates advanced mobile automation patterns with sleep statements for timing-sensitive operations, multiple exception handling strategies, and extensive logging for debugging. Notable implementation includes dynamic GA (Google Analytics) tracking for printer counts and special handling for moobe printers with retry logic.
